params.caption: 🖥️ Hacker turns an 8GB Nvidia mining card into a full 80GB A100 A modder took a $2,500 Nvidia CMP-170HX 8GB cryptomining GPU and used voltage glitching to unlock it as a full A100 80GB, a card worth around $20,000. The trick involved carefully blowing fuses on the board to open up the entire VRAM and all shader modules. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 13:30 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 🤯 React if this blew your mind · 💬 Would you risk your GPU for this? #Nvidia #GPU #GamingNews
